components.name: Scrollbar
components.description: Scroll bar — based on standard behaviour. Track + thumb, both orientations, two widths, three states. Thumb length is calculated from the content ratio and never drops below size/scrollbar-thumb/min (32px). Colours are on the alpha (neutral-a) scale, so it works on any surface.

Do / Don’t
Three pairs — visibility, thumb length and horizontal scroll.
Do
When content doesn’t fit, the scroll bar is visible. The user immediately understands there is more below.
Don’t
Scroll hidden with scrollbar-width: none. The content is cut off but nothing indicates it — affordance and accessibility are both lost.
Do
Even with very long content, the thumb is never shorter than 32px — it can be grabbed with a mouse.
Don’t
The thumb has shrunk to a dot following the content ratio. It can’t be grabbed, and its position can’t be read.
Do
Inside a table
Horizontal scroll inside an inner container — a table, code block or carousel. The page outside the container doesn’t move.
Don’t
On the page itself
Horizontal scroll on the page itself. This is almost always a layout bug: the content didn’t fit its container and the scroll hid the problem.
